title: The reviewer-model refusal names the Round N of 3 marker in its remedy
why: Second incident for note reviewer-round-model-unchecked (coordinator, Nov 1 09:34 CST): a round-2 or round-3 reviewer spawned on sonnet with no `Round N of 3` marker in its brief is refused by guard agent-role-model with ROLE_MODEL_REASON (hooks/guard.py), whose remedy says only 'drop the model field, or name the role's model' and never names the marker. Lane renovate-917-918 read it as a rule conflict and fell back to haiku twice, against rule roles-third-round-steps-up.
note: Triage judged it a debt with an incident (roles-findings-are-debts-or-notes): a second case, and every round-2 reviewer spawn can meet it. Fix the cause in one home: when the role is reviewer, the refusal's remedy names the `Round N of 3` first-line marker and the rounds that allow it, read from ROLE_REVIEWER_FREE_ROUNDS, never a copy (rule building-allow-list-is-the-constant). The lane promotes note reviewer-round-model-unchecked to debt record reviewer-round-model-unchecked and closes it with the fix. Done check: a guard test spawns a reviewer on sonnet with no marker and finds the marker text in the refusal, red on main and green on the fix; a reviewer with `Round 2 of 3` still passes. Needs no answer. Files: hooks/guard.py, hooks/test_guard.py, docs/debts/notes.md. Lane session_013NEJL345c2sdUgNz5Er3XM, started Nov 1 09:35 CST (coordinator).
